mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals disinflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 70% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3 percentage points simultaneously, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 10% and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% and real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% over the same quarter, it signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and GDPC1 grows > 2% in the same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% and GDPC1 grows > 2% in the same quarter.
